_about: Michael's War Room rules (guillotine playbook). Change a number here and the next build uses it. reserve: dollars always kept back. league_winners: players he has named worth big money; everyone else is capped at big_bid_share of his FAAB (at least big_bid_min). marginal_pts_per_week: a claim adding fewer lineup points a week than this (and any K or DEF) goes in at $0.
